Rector of Sutton Coldfield, uncle of Ann Carter Smith

Educated at Westminster and Trinity College, Cambridge, priest 1829, Headmaster of Westminster School 1828-1846, Rector of Sutton Coldfield 1844-50, Vicar of Pershore 1850-66, Hon. Canon of Worcester; he married (1833) Anne Gray, daughter of the Bishop of Bristol, uncle of Ann Carter Smith. [Alumni Cantabrigienses]
